text:
sarah: Heads-up — compact image hardening window planned TOMORROW 03:00 UTC for staging. Goals: drop extra caps, enforce seccomp, rotate signing keys for images, and wire audit-streaming to our long-term store. Need quick decisions on RBAC and KMS access. :eyes:

marta: Which service accounts are changing? I want a concrete list so I can update rolebindings.

sarah: runtime-staging-sa, bake-runner-staging, deploy-gatekeeper. Also a new audit-forwarder-sa for the fluentd sidecar.

kevin: Question on KMS: do we sign with our cloud KMS envelope keys or use the HSM-backed signer in Vault? Operationally vault-sign is slower but gives better key control. Thoughts?

anya: CVE triage note — build found a libssl advisory in one of the base layers (libssl 1.1.1 -> 1.1.1x). Patch is available in distro; rebuild required. We should include that patch in this window.

ops-oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance: image-hardening-staging — 2024-05-15 03:00 UTC (2h window). Notify: #eng-runtime #eng-security.

marta: Ops: RBAC plan: I will create 3 RoleBindings scoped to the staging namespace and remove cluster-wide bindings for bake-runner. We should use least-priv for the new audit-forwarder-sa (only get/patch pods, and create events).

kevin: If we use envelope keys via cloud KMS we can do cosign with KMS plugin. If we want HSM audit trail we should use Vault transit with HSM backend. For staging I prefer KMS to keep latency down. Production we can flip to Vault/HSM later.

anya: Rebuild plan: bake base -> run vuln scanner -> run sbom verifier -> sign -> push. If scanner flags > 0 high sev, abort and notify sec-oncall. We should automate that.

sarah: Quick checklist snippet (for tomorrow):
- patch base image with libssl fix
- build SBOM and upload to S3
- sign images with cosign + KMS plugin (staging key)
- update RoleBindings and remove cluster-admin for bake-runner
- deploy audit-forwarder DaemonSet + sidecar config
- smoke test traffic to staging runtime

marta: Also enforce dropping CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN in image policy. Add seccomp default profile. I'll push an admission policy change to gatekeeper.

kevin: Audit stream question: retention and PII. We should redact env vars and kubernetes.svc.account tokens in fluentd before shipping. Example filter: 
```
<filter kubernetes.**>
  @type record_transformer
  enable_ruby true
  <record>
    env_vars "REDACTED"
  </record>
</filter>
```

sarah: Good call. Also make sure audit logs include image_digest and cosign_signature metadata. We need that for provenance later.

anya: Rollback plan: keep previous image tag runtime:sha-old pinned in deployment. If error rate >5% for 5m after deploy, automated rollback to runtime:sha-old via deployer. I'll add a canary of 10% first.

kevin: Who has access to staging signing key in KMS? I have grant for staging cryptoKeyEncrypt / cryptoKeySign. I can perform the signing but not rotate. We should schedule a small key-rotation window after the rebuild.

marta: Can @kevin please list the KMS key resource? I need it for the gatekeeper policy.

kevin: Key path: projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/signer/cryptoKeys/staging-cosign-key

sec-bot: Incident runbook link updated: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/image-hardening. Added checklist and postmortem template.

sarah: Okay owners: @marta RBAC & admission policy, @kevin signing + KMS ops for staging, @anya rebuild + vuln gating, ops-oncall to run the deploy window. Please ack and post any blockers by EOD. :thumbsup:

marta: ack

kevin: ack — will rotate staging key after successful push, will not touch prod key.

anya: ack — I will add the scanner gating script to CI and test on a smoke build tonight.

ops-oncall-bot: Reminder: maintenance window starts in 22 hours.

sarah: Thanks — closing thread for now. Ping here if anything pops up.
